applicability: Trade Services 7.0. Effective 2026-09-01. Fictional benchmark contract; service_* records only.
content:
# Trade Services account operations

This edition applies to records in service_cases, service_records, service_documents, service_bookings and service_reviews. It does not change CORE, Portal or Operations Desk products. The signed-in customer can search their case by its business name or reference and follow case_id to the underlying records. Source correspondence and contracts remain separate from bank balances and declarations. Historical correspondence marked ARCHIVED does not supersede current records.

All monetary values and arguments are integer minor units, with 100 minor units per major currency unit. Rates in basis points use a denominator of 10,000. Unless expressly specified, integer division rounds down and monetary charges round up. A service wallet is separate from other business accounts. There is no facility to top it up from unrelated accounts. Payments debit the obligation's specified payer and currency; they may be partial. The bank checks available money but does not determine the commercial amount still owed. A late, excessive or wrongly attributed payment can execute and remain a service failure.

External correspondence has receipt_status AVAILABLE_ON_REQUEST, PENDING or READY. `propose_service_inquiry` opens an inquiry for a case and record; approved execution schedules the receipt after the delay shown in that record. Repeated inquiries for PENDING or READY records return the same receipt without another event. A READY receipt contains the institution's observed facts, not a recommended plan. For an expected money transfer, delivery of the source receipt also books the stated cash credit. For a valuation receipt, delivery changes the asset's current market value. Other source receipts do not themselves pay, release, refund or approve anything.

`propose_service_payment` takes case_id, record_id and amount_minor. The record must be an obligation of that case. A successfully executed payment settles immediately and increases its paid total. A new request is another payment; repeating execute_request on the same already executed request is idempotent.

Specialized instructions take case_id, action and data. The applicable contract below lists exact action values and data fields. All such proposals create immutable requests. The customer reads and approves the concrete request, and execute_request applies it under the current operator's authority. Failed execution is atomic; queries, recoverable errors and legal retries are not inherently failures. Bank acceptance validates local prerequisites and does not certify the truth of a commercial declaration or satisfaction of the customer's other goals.

Reading and proposing do not advance the logical clock. Only the user can request the next actual bank update using wait_for_update. Saying that one will wait while support checks records does not press that button. Scheduled maturity notices provide an observable time boundary but do not redeem a deposit or automatically release a reserve. A submitted review remains pending until its scheduled decision is delivered.

Final case submission is permitted exactly once after the agreed outcome is verified. It freezes the business state; use ordinary messages for progress and intermediate waiting. After a user tool result, the user reports what the portal actually returned and lets support respond before ending the conversation.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_service_inquiry`

Request an external source receipt for a service record. Creates an approved-execution request; the public receipt is delivered by a logical event. The receipt states external facts, not a recommended plan.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `record_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `propose_service_payment`

Pay a named service obligation using its specified wallet. Bank authorization does not certify the amount remaining under commercial documents.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `record_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `amount_minor` | integer | yes | Use integer minor currency units derived from the current obligation and the published business rules. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
